#官方确认帮扶老人遭索赔店主不担责#
#胡锡进谈湖南扶老人被索赔#
#薛之谦连发62个问号为帮扶店主发声#
连雅思口语考试里都有帮助他人的话题：Describe a person who often helps others；可以把这个新闻作为语料素材：I’d like to talk about a female shop owner I recently saw on the news, who truly embodies the spirit of helping others.
One day, an elderly man suddenly fainted while resting in her shop. Without hesitation, she decided to lend a helping hand. She immediately supported the man and called an ambulance. Unfortunately, the man passed away later, and his family demanded money, claiming she was responsible. Although authorities confirmed she was not at fault, she was falsely accused by the grieving family and had to pay a humanitarian compensation to settle the dispute.
Despite the pressure and the financial loss, she stated she would still help people in need. I was deeply moved by her innate kindness. In today's society, many people might weigh the risks before acting, fearing they might get into trouble. But she chose compassion over self-protection. Her bravery reminds us that true kindness requires courage, and we should never let fear stop us from doing the right thing.
关键词汇：在讲述时，可以使用一些高级词汇来提升表达，例如：
Humanitarian compensation (人道主义补偿)
Innate kindness (与生俱来的善良)
Weigh the risks (权衡风险)
Lend a helping hand (伸出援手)
Falsely accused (被诬告/被讹诈)
